surprise.title: Carnival Paradise was built to be the world's first smoke-free cruise ship
surprise.body: Before tonight's bus, here is a little about the ship you board tomorrow in Tampa. Carnival Paradise was built at the Helsinki New Shipyard in Finland and floated out on January 29, 1998, then christened by Paula Zahn. She launched as the world's first completely non-smoking cruise ship, with No Smoking painted on both sides and the stern, and anyone caught smoking was fined $250 and put off at the next port. Carnival dropped the policy in December 2003, and when she reached Long Beach in 2004 after dodging a string of hurricanes, the signs were painted over that same day. She has sailed from Tampa since late 2011, and a 2018 dry dock in Freeport added a fourteenth deck at the bow with 38 new cabins. Happy Halloween, and one day to sailing.
